activation.reason: Owner explicitly requested making the improved PR11 profile the main solution after the clean/distance versus fault tradeoff was disclosed.
activation.known_tradeoff: Compared with v5, clean group-macro RMSE -2.2722%, scalar span distance RMSE -1.1627%, fault-event RMSE +1.9585%. This is an owner-directed choice, not a retroactive change of the earlier 0.5% automatic-promotion gate.
activation.historical_v4_archive: Preserve byte-for-byte. No old final-test claim is inherited by v6.

next_task: Reduce the fault regression of time-aligned odometry while preserving its clean-speed and scalar-distance advantage.

data_policy.bags: The existing 19 validation bags, all receivers and the unchanged main fault windows.
data_policy.test_access: No test measurement reads or re-evaluation. Existing validation has been reused adaptively; no independent generalization claim.

hypotheses.name: paired_only
hypotheses.rule: Apply compensation and its noise allowance only when both new accepted wheel samples agree. Never increase trust in a single wheel during a detected asymmetric fault.

hypotheses.name: paired_cooldown
hypotheses.rule: As paired_only; after range/rate/model/pair/stale/command failure, suppress compensation for one second. Prediction-only duplicate ticks do not restart the cooldown.

hypotheses.name: residual_weight
hypotheses.rule: On an accepted agreeing pair, multiply compensation by max(0,1-(abs(raw_mean-model_prediction)/innovation_floor_mps)^2). Single-wheel compensation is disabled. Keep raw samples for all gates and adaptation.

invariants: same output schedule and reference mask
both measured baselines reproduce published values

acceptance.on_failure: Preserve the requested v6 default, publish rejected hypotheses; do not soften gates or label the round successful.

checkpoints: Push plan, code, per-bag results, failures, decision and test outcomes. Compare main again before merging; never force-push or overwrite another contributor's work.
